conventions.step: one policy action = 10 physics substeps of 4 ms = 40 ms; checks are sampled once per action (eval_env.py:457)
conventions.stages: check() calls form ordered stages; only the first pending stage is evaluated; it pops the first step all its predicates hold and never needs to hold again (reward_manager.py:376-389)
conventions.success: all stages, final checks and trigger checks popped, and every query count equal to its aim; the episode ends at that sample (reward_manager.py:527-587, eval_env.py:841-860)
conventions.nested_lists: inside a stage a list is OR, a list inside that is AND, alternating (reward_manager.py:247-279)
conventions.queries: count steps (or transition events) on which a condition holds; count > aim fails the episode at once (reward_manager.py:362-375)
conventions.score: failures score process_score/100; for transition/by_count the last tier is withheld from failures only if it equals 100 (reward_manager.py:589-632)
conventions.in_B: is_A_in_B: A's root xy inside B's oriented-bbox footprint and above B's bbox bottom; no top or wall test (func_parser.py:168-204)
conventions.depth_in_B: B bbox top minus A bbox bottom > threshold (func_parser.py:911-946)
conventions.plausibility: how likely a learned or scripted policy reaches the test state; status 'unwitnessed' means not run
